description: We're a creative and curious team ready to explore new ideas, solve challenges, and think beyond the ordinary. We bring creativity, design, and teamwork, and we're looking for enthusiastic members with skills in coding, science, research, or anything that adds a new perspective. Join us and let's make something out of this world!
summary:
We developed a space exploration game that takes players across the Moon and Mars to discover abandoned spacecraft, landers, rovers, and equipment. Through missions and storytelling, it explains why objects remain and how they may affect future exploration. The game makes the issue engaging, builds awareness, and inspires responsible space exploration.

Note : This project is currently a prototype. Therefore, certain features, including audio narration and sound effects intended to support the storytelling experience, and some may not be fully functional.
details:
Our project is an interactive space exploration game focused on abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. Players explore planetary surfaces, discover abandoned spacecraft, landers, rovers and scientific instruments, by following footsteps of astronauts who visited previously which leads them to the equipment. The player clicks and walks through the equipment to hear the audio of the story behind their original missions, why they were left behind and how they may affect future exploration.

The game addresses the lack of awareness surrounding abandoned space equipment by transforming scientific information into an engaging, interactive learning experience.

By combining education, science, storytelling and gaming, our project makes space exploration more accessible, particularly to young learners, while encouraging curiosity and interest in STEM.

We developed our game using G Develop, with Claude as an AI development assistant. We used the official NASA website to research historical space missions and scientific information. We also created 3D visual assets to make the planetary environments and equipment more immersive.
